info.name: Car Fuel & Maintenance
info.summary: Track fuel fill-ups and maintenance history for your cars
info.description: Log fuel fill-ups, maintenance work, trips and a spare-parts inventory for as many cars as you own, including bifuel vehicles. Fill-ups compute fuel consumption and cost automatically per fuel type; maintenance entries support due-date and due-mileage reminders, backed by real Nextcloud notifications. Track total cost of ownership and per-trip costs (including tolls), and manage a photographed parts stock linked to your cars. Includes a token-friendly API so a script or an AI assistant can log entries for you.
info.author: Ricardo
